build_preprocessors: build the default set of Markdown preprocessors including normalize_whitespace and html_block registered in a Registry
create_custom_preprocessor: create a custom preprocessor by subclassing Preprocessor and overriding the run method to modify document lines
normalize_whitespace: normalize whitespace in Markdown source text by replacing CRLF, expanding tabs, and stripping trailing spaces
extract_html_blocks: extract HTML blocks from Markdown source text and store them in the htmlStash for later retrieval
run_preprocessor: run a preprocessor on a list of document lines and return the modified list of lines
